method: Independent second reads of twelve families this verifier did not build. Per family: claim asserted through claim.mjs before any artifact was read, and released after the verdict; verify-packet-completeness.mjs run fresh at the base sha and the result read directly; canonical and boundary fixture bytes rehashed against reports/rendered-artifacts.json; route keys compared across production-field-map.json, product-wiring.json, the MASTER_QUEUE row and the canonical route universe; statute, jurisdiction, participant prefills, placeholder markers and wrong-state names checked by text extraction of the canonical fixture; filing instructions, blank disclosure and approval posture read from the family directory. The two repaired Utah families were re-read against the exact four obligations their prior FAIL named, from the repair commits' actual content, not from the repair claims.
